additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421579-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001123] Charging Issue CRM:02699000065
additional_info.body:
Hi Yunus,
Apologies for delay in response.
I have checked last 6 weeks logs and found IMD_BC1, IMD_BC2, DC1_CabelTemp error messages.
For IMD errors, mostly it was Insulation drop and Modbus connection issue and for DC1_CableTemp, it was mostly plausibility error.
I have also checked the Cable Temp sensors remotely, and didn't find much difference between the sensor values.
But still, could you please plan a site visit to check the Cable Temp sensors resistance and also the IMDs modbus connections and configurations.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
